scope: opening single-member MOVE state, walking, held/tap running, crouch, direction and moved signal count at 60Hz; not entire Player class
semantic_review: _move computes velocity using previous speed before walking/running chooses the next speed
velocity is scaled by explicit delta and speed/1.7 before Godot move_and_slide applies the physics step
substantial movement rounds the actual displacement before final position rounding
idle toggle enters/exits crouch; releasing a crouch without teleport starts tap running
diagonal controls are rounded to component signs; no additional normalization
threshold := 0 is a Godot-inferred integer parameter; fractional supplied thresholds are coerced to int before the function
paused/entering-door gates suppress movement as in _move_state

reference_overrides._set_running: retain running flag; audio playback excluded
reference_overrides._update_party_positions: single-member movement test excludes follower history
reference_overrides.animation interfaces: record requested state; AnimationTree evaluation excluded
reference_overrides._party_member: opening member without teleport/relay; unsupported skill requests assert
reference_overrides.global: one party member, not entering a door; no cutscene or interaction
reference_overrides.audioManager: no audio player; audio callbacks excluded
